Interview Experience
Darshan Shelar
B-Tech, Information Technology

Online Assessment
Online Test conducted on Hackerrank Platform having 4 Questions to be completed within 120 
Minutes.
Test consisted of 2 difficult and 2 easy questions.
Preparation: Keep practicing on coding platforms like codechef, Leetcode, 450DSA, Striver sheet, etc.
General tips: Make sure you attempt all the questions.
In this round, I was able to completely solve only one difficult question and the other question solved 
10 test cases.
You can find some of the questions in this site https://www.thejoboverflow.com/p/p1428/

Online Assessment: Questions asked
1. Count User Logins: you are given an array of array in which each array is of form 
[“user1”,”09:00:00”,”2021-01-01”]  Username, time at which user logs in(24 hr format), date of login(YYYY-
MM-DD)  . You have to find how many times a user logged in on a particular day.
2. Binary Storage: You’re given a binary 2D array of size NxM, each row of the matrix had some value x 
denoting the xth bit of the current number is set. Consider arr[] = {3,2,1} meaning the number would be 
1110 which is equivalent to 14, similarly, other N rows would contribute some value you have to sort in 
descending order of values and return the indices according to row number.
3. Upgrade or sell: You have many systems for which you have to increase security. You are given multiple 
arrays: system no. (sr no. of system), quantity (how many machines are available in system), Selling price 
(how much you will get is you sell one machine in a system), Upgrade cost (How much you need to spend 
in order to upgrade a machine in the system), cash you currently have for a system (Note: you can use I’th
cash only on I’th system). You want to upgrade as many machines as possible.
You can sell the machines if you are falling short on cash. Print how many machines can be upgraded.

Online Assessment: Questions asked
4. Team Formation: Given a list of employees, where each is assigned a numeric score, and there are 
certain rules for finding the sum of scores of selected employees.
Rules –
1. The employee with the highest score among the first k employees or the last k employees in the score list is selected. 
2. Selected Employee is removed from the score list.
3. The process continues until team_size is achieved.
Example -
score[] = [10, 20, 10, 15, 5, 30, 20], team_size = 2, k = 3
Initially, we select first k i.e [10, 20, 10] or last k [5, 30, 20] so, 30 is selected and removed from the list.
Second time, we have first k i.e [10,20,10] or last k [15,5,20] we take 20 and remove it.
Thus our team reaches a size of team_size so we stop and return 30 + 20 = 50.

Interview
Interview consisted of 3 rounds: 2 technical and one HR.
Preparation:
You should be able to explain your whole resume.
Keep practicing on coding platforms like codechef, Leetcode, etc. In interviews, only easy problems 
are asked.
Go through OS and DBMS questions on Interviewbits.
Practice SQL queries, specially the join ones.
Make sure you are aware of all OOPs concepts specifically the inheritance and classes part.
Prepare all the known sorting algorithms with their pseudocode (Bubble sort, Insertion sort and 
Selection sort are simplest and most asked ones). 
Practice for the data structures along with pseudocode (Stack, Queue, Linked List, trees and graphs 
and their functions and algorithms).

Interview
Go through Interviewbit site’s frequently asked questions
General tips:
Be confident and clear.
If you don’t know the answer, just say so.
Make sure that you are not saying any fake/unstudied terms. Because they will cross question you.

Interview: Technical round 1
1. You are given 2 arrays, you need to concatenate and sort the arrays.
2. Explain queue, give pseudocode for the same. Give step by step explanation for enqueue function.
3. You are given an array, find the max element.
4. Mention some sorting algorithms, give pseudocode and step by step explanation for any one of 
your choice.
5. Give an example of how an object is declared in C++/Java, explain what is the object, datatype, etc.
Can you use a data type other than int, string, etc (explain about classes).
6. Explain classes in python, application based questions on scope of variables. 
7. Explain inheritance with an example.
8. Difference between procedure oriented language and object oriented language. Give examples and 
compare them (Python vs Java).

Interview: Technical round 2
1. Explain projects mentioned in your resume.
2 DBMS question: explain joins.
3. OS question: difference between process and threads.
4. Explain the projects you completed in your internship.

Interview: HR round
1. Tell me about the interview process today.
2. Tell me about your internship.
3. You have used less technologies in your projects (In resume I mentioned only web-D and Python 
projects).
4. If you need to learn a new technology, how much time will you take and how can you assure us 
that you will learn it properly?
5. Why BNY Mellon?

Tips
1. Make sure you enter with a smile and greet them because your first impression can have a lot of 
impact.
2. Make sure that the Interviewer understands what you explain. You will find his satisfaction from 
your answer based on his expressions.
3. Stay calm listen properly and be confident while speaking.
4. Prepare the “Tell me about yourself” and a few common HR questions beforehand.
5. For a DSA Question, try to think out loud and share your ideas with the interviewer.
